title: Style learning that sees the whole channel
items: New: Style cloning looks before it learns. Studio measures a few minutes of each video (cuts, motion, colour, music and sound effects) and ChannelRecipe's Gemini watches them, then shows what it saw: the recipe it recommends, every setting with its reason, and the cost per minute. Nothing runs on your Claude or picture accounts until you continue.

New: Learned styles keep the channel's own look instead of the starting recipe's: picture style, how people are drawn, pace, camera moves, colour, captions, music level, sound effects and narrator, with a script voice written for the channel.

New: Choose the picture style every video keeps. After a study, Studio draws three sample pictures in the learned style; the one you pick is copied by every picture, and a channel host gets a character sheet.
New: Music written for each video. Styles whose channels use music get one cue per section, made for that video in the channel's own sound on your Kie account (about 6 cents a section).
New: Recorded sound effects (whooshes, hits, risers, paper, marker, coins) for learned styles, placed on the actions your pictures show.
Improved: Learned styles draw with Nano Banana 2.1, which keeps the style and draws whole people, at the same price per picture. A picture model you chose in Setup still comes first.
Improved: Pictures are made four at a time, so a video's pictures finish sooner.
Improved: Moving pictures copy the same style drawing as the stills.
Improved: What's new marks each change as new, improved or fixed.
Fixed: Studio re-runs its daily Claude model check by itself instead of sending you back to setup.

title: Steadier writing with API accounts
items: Fixed: videos using an API account could lose parts of their research with "The brain is busy", "could not answer" or "This request stopped". Studio now queues its requests and waits patiently, and a request is never paid for twice.
When your AI account is rate limited, Studio waits and tries again instead of stopping.

title: Every option for learned styles
items: Styles you learn in Mixed media now offer every option in Create (sound design, motion graphics, maps, footage and more), not just the few their starting recipe had. Your styles' current choices stay as they were.
The style study page explains the two Video look modes and which channels each suits.

title: Easier to get help
items: Copy diagnostics: one button on the setup page and in the sidebar copies everything support needs (never your keys). Paste it in Discord #help.
The Studio window now says clearly that Studio is running, and no longer fills up with page requests.
Opening Studio twice just brings up the one that's already running.

title: Always opens the right screen
items: Fixed: if Studio was started a different way (for example by Claude Code running the engine directly), it opened an older screen without setup. Studio now always opens its own setup and workspace.

title: Style learning on Macs with less free space
items: Fixed: on a Mac with under 20 GB of free disk space, learning a style stopped near the end. It now needs about 3 GB.
Fixed: Level-Up Stories could wait forever on a Mac with little free disk space.
Voice previews play instantly, at no cost to your account.

title: Style learning fixed
items: Fixed: previewing a YouTube channel to learn its style failed with "The study could not complete this step".

title: Choose your narration voice
items: Pick from 70 Gemini voices right on the Create page: press Choose voice in Narration & sound.
Hear a short preview of any voice before you choose it. Search by name or by style, like warm, deep or clear.

title: Faster thumbnails and one-click updates
items: Recipe thumbnails load much faster and stay cached.
Learning a style from a YouTube channel works on more computers, and says exactly why when YouTube refuses a link.
Update Studio from inside Studio. It downloads only what changed and restarts in a few seconds.
See what's new before you update. Updating is always your choice; your current version keeps working.

title: Easier setup
items: Connect your ChannelRecipe account with one click. No key to copy.
Setup is three steps with one button each, and every button shows when it's working.
Set up Claude for videos in one click.

title: Windows fix
items: Fixed: on some Windows computers the recipe list didn't load.

title: Fast mode fixed
items: Fixed: Fast mode (quick 3D graphics) couldn't finish its setup. Its setup button now sits right next to the switch.

title: New look
items: The new ChannelRecipe logo.

title: Recipe previews
items: Every recipe shows a style reference, so you can see the look before you pick it.
Recipe names that say what they make, like True Crime Case Files and Dark History 3D.
